summary_en: Update on progress toward capital-cost and share-price-conscious management. Board evaluation and improvement initiatives as of 2026-06-09. Detailed metrics in attached materials.
title_en: Update on Measures toward Realizing Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Share Price
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-09, the board of Ishii Hyoki Co., Ltd. held a meeting to evaluate current progress and update stakeholders on improvements being made toward realizing management conscious of capital cost and share price. The disclosure confirms the company is actively assessing its position on these strategic initiatives. Specific metrics, targets, and detailed action plans are contained in the attached supplementary materials referenced in the filing. The update reflects the company's ongoing commitment to align capital allocation and strategic decision-making with cost-of-capital considerations and shareholder value creation.
